comment: A second, blue pair of sliders is declared at exactly the same position as the white pair. The widget's step() sets visible on each of the four, so exactly one slider of each pair is on screen at a time: the white one while the cut is set by hand, the blue one while a CV is patched. Each is therefore reachable in its own mode and gets its own line. Nothing in the module ever reads the blue pair — they are written by process() and never read — so their lines say so.
